beats: The seals are broken and the hills are quieter for it. There is one more thing I would ask of you.
Orin's word reached me, and I have not stopped thinking about it since. Sit; there is a last errand.

text: Three old things slumber under three old places, and they are the reason the seals existed at all. {boss} first, in the {structure}. I won't pretend it's a fair ask.
The three keepers must die, and I mean all three. {boss} is the first, {danger}, in the {structure}.
Three keepers still hold the wards. {boss} first, in the {structure}: {danger}, but you have earned this fight.
Three keepers, three fights. Start with {boss}, in the {structure}.
Three small keepers, three small errands. Start with {boss}, in the {structure}.
Three keepers still linger. The nearest is {boss}, in the {structure}.

beats.text: Three keepers hold the last wards. I cannot say what they are. Only where they sleep.

text: Are you ready to end it?

found.text: All three, then. Will you go?

thanks.text: All three. I had stopped daring to hope.

thanks: Take what the vault gave up, and my thanks with it. The hills owe you.
